item.title: Festivals
item.description: At My Discombobulated Brain, we believe festivals should be spaces where everyone feels safe, supported, and free to enjoy the energy of the event. We’re here to make sure that mental health and well-being are prioritised, safeguarding your guests and providing the support they need to fully embrace your event.

item.title: Events
item.description: Creating safer, more inclusive events through wellbeing support, training, and education.

item.title: Resources
item.description: We provide a wide range of mental health resources designed to support wellbeing and make accessing help easier. From informative mental health booklets and pocket-sized help cards to our innovative GeoLocation App, our resources provide practical advice, trusted information, and access to support whenever and wherever it’s needed.
